t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the gnomes will be in pairs blue and purple, red and yellow etc. Half of them will lead me to a bright forest (dependent on the colour of the gnome) and the other half will lead me to a dark forest.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will appear in pairs. The pairs will be brown and orange (remember to pick orange!), red and yellow (remember to pick yellow!), blue and purple (remember to pick blue!) and pink and green (remember to pick pink!).The background of the forest is irrelevant as well as the height of the gnomes hat.Good luck!
